title: Best Time to Buy and Sell Stock
description:
prices[i] is a stock's price on day i. Buy on one day and sell on a later day. Return the largest profit, or 0 if no trade makes money.

[7, 1, 5, 3, 6, 4] → 5 (buy at 1, sell at 6)
[7, 6, 4, 3, 1] → 0
tracePrompt: Trace of [7, 1, 5, 3, 6, 4]: one row per day

tests.name: Lowest price comes after the highest
New low, then a bigger gain
